title: רבינא זוטי

paragraphs: Yuhasin describes Ravina Zuti as the sister’s son of Ravina the Earlier and places him before Rav Sheshet in the chapter Almanah Nizonet. There is also an account involving Ravina Zuti and Rav Ashi. In that chapter (Ketubot 100b), Ravina held wine belonging to Ravina Zuti, his sister’s orphaned son. Ravina asked Rav Ashi whether he might take it on a ship, since there was concern it might sink. Thus you see that there is one, not two: Ravina Zuti is the sister's son of Ravina the Later, who asked Rav Ashi—not before Rav Sheshet.
